Tabby Web - an SSH/Telnet/Serial client in your browser.

This is the Tabby terminal, served as a web app. It also provides the config sync service for the Tabby app.
Tabby Web serves the Tabby Terminal as a web application while managing multiple config files, authentication, and providing TCP connections via a separate gateway service.

data.name: wnr/element-resize-detector
data.enhanced_text:
Optimized cross-browser resize listener for elements.

Include the script in the browser:
This will create a global function , which is the maker function that makes an element resize detector instance.
flex: nonecallOnAddonAnimationStartoptions.idHandler.getdir=RTLuninstalluninstalluninstalluninstalllistenTowindow.getComputedStyle` instead of relying on the method being available in the global scope. This enables this library to be used in simulated browser environments such as jsdom.
* Event-based solution for detecting attached/rendered events so that detached/unrendered elements can be listened to without polling
* Now all changes that affects the offset size of an element are properly detected (such as padding and font-size).
